_meta.tool_description:
Run the real SHELXL-2019/3 on the current model as an independent engine: writes a complete .ins (atoms, AFIX riding H, restraint cards, WGHT, solvent mask exported as ABIN .fab), executes shelxl, parses R1/wR2/GooF. mode='check' only reports agreement with the in-process engine; mode='adopt' additionally takes the SHELXL-refined model back into the session as a new node (keeping the WGHT it ran with); mode='adopt_wght' is the weighting-scheme convergence loop: it copies the WGHT SHELXL suggests at the end of each job into the next job (.res -> .ins, the model is not re-serialized in between) until suggested and used agree or wght_rounds extra jobs ran, then adopts the last job - use it once the model is essentially complete (mask/disorder settled), and read wght_loop.history for the GooF trail. Riding H are re-derived per carrier on adopt (replaced, never duplicated; labels of the adopted model are kept). Use as cross-validation before finalizing. Both modes read back the whole .lst: SHELXL's own ** banners, the analysis of variance (K vs Fc and vs resolution - the trend test §17.4 gives for a weighting scheme, not GooF), the most disagreeable reflections with the direction of their Fo^2-Fc^2 imbalance and any shared index relation, restraint residuals over 3 sigma, and the convergence reading. BUDGET: each SHELXL job is killed at timeout_s (default 300 s) and the tool returns ok=false naming how far it got, with the session unchanged; mode='adopt_wght' runs up to 1+wght_rounds jobs in sequence, so its ceiling is that multiple (~1500 s by default) - it is still the CHEAP way to settle weights on a large model, far cheaper than optimize_weights.
Params: mode: check|adopt|adopt_wght = check; l_s: integer = 8; timeout_s: integer = 300; wght_rounds: integer = 4; extra_cards: [string]; reason: string; replace_cards: boolean = false.

_meta.tool_description:
Record the research goal of this project, its success tiers, what has been ruled out and which directions are still untried (.crystalpilot/refine/investigation.json). Two tiers: candidate_complete (a whole-feature candidate is in the model and refines stably) and scientifically_established (it survives the independent tests and checkCIF is explainable). A failed route rules out ONE configuration, never the goal: write it under rule_out with the evidence and move to an open direction. situation_report shows this record (open_items.investigation); a 'diagnostic' finalize_delivery writes the unmet tiers and the open directions into open_items and refuses to seal when neither this record nor its unmet_goals parameter says what was not achieved. Partial update: only the fields given change. Never modifies the model; no node is created.

Run the real SHELXL-2019/3 on the current model as an independent engine: writes a complete .ins (atoms, AFIX riding H, restraint cards, WGHT, solvent mask exported as ABIN .fab), executes shelxl, parses R1/wR2/GooF. mode='check' only reports agreement with the in-process engine; mode='adopt' additionally takes the SHELXL-refined model back into the session as a new node (keeping the WGHT it ran with); mode='adopt_wght' is the weighting-scheme convergence loop: it copies the WGHT SHELXL suggests at the end of each job into the next job (.res -> .ins, the model is not re-serialized in between) until suggested and used agree or wght_rounds extra jobs ran, then adopts the last job - use it once the model is essentially complete (mask/disorder settled), and read wght_loop.history for the GooF trail. Riding H are re-derived per carrier on adopt (replaced, never duplicated; labels of the adopted model are kept). Use as cross-validation before finalizing. Both modes read back the whole .lst: SHELXL's own ** banners, the analysis of variance (K vs Fc and vs resolution - the trend test §17.4 gives for a weighting scheme, not GooF), the most disagreeable reflections with the direction of their Fo^2-Fc^2 imbalance and any shared index relation, restraint residuals over 3 sigma, and the convergence reading. BUDGET: each SHELXL job is killed at timeout_s (default 300 s) and the tool returns ok=false naming how far it got, with the session unchanged; mode='adopt_wght' runs up to 1+wght_rounds jobs in sequence, so its ceiling is that multiple (~1500 s by default) - it is still the CHEAP way to settle weights on a large model, far cheaper than optimize_weights.
Params: mode: check|adopt|adopt_wght = check; l_s: integer = 8; timeout_s: integer = 300; wght_rounds: integer = 4; extra_cards: [string]; reason: string; replace_cards: boolean = false.

_meta.tool_description:
Write the final deliverables from the ACTIVE node into an output directory: final.res (SHELX), final.cif (PUBLICATION-grade when a matching run_shelxl job exists: SHELXL ACTA backbone with esds + experiment metadata + solvent-mask documentation), final.fcf (structure factors), REPORT.json (metrics, node lineage, restraints, synthesis priors, CIF caveats). PAIRING SEMANTICS: the publication CIF is assembled from the newest COMPLETED run_shelxl job whose MODEL is the active node's - R1 within 0.005, same atom/H/FVAR counts (FVARs within 0.02), same non-H labels and element types, same ZERR-Z and mask state (the chosen job is returned as shelxl_job; every rejection reason is listed in job_mismatches, and a refusal spells out the conditions with the numbers seen in job_match). So run run_shelxl FIRST, and re-run it after anything that changes the MODEL (edits, renames, retypes, set_z, set_weights, mask on/off) - otherwise the newest matching job is stale or absent and you get a minimal CIF. Metadata-only changes (set_experiment: experiment / instrument / chemistry) need NO rerun: final.cif takes the job's model plus the session's metadata at write time. List unresolved issues honestly in 'unresolved'. Masked deliveries also get final.fab (the job's ABIN coefficients; final.res gains the ABIN card) and return mask_obligations - the reporting duties (moiety with guest estimate, electron-count chemistry in VALIDATION.md) the delivery still owes; settle them before finishing. STATUS: every delivery carries a machine-readable status (comment header of final.cif + REPORT.json): 'provisional' (default; a structure claim awaiting checkCIF / VALIDATION.md), 'diagnostic' (NOT a structure claim - a rejected space group, trial element or unmasked comparison kept for the record; finalize_delivery can still SEAL it into an audited MANIFEST without ever promoting it), 'final' (only finalize_delivery grants it). The reply returns key_facts (R1/wR2/GooF/formula/Z/mask numbers) and cif_missing_metadata (each '?' slot with the checkCIF alert it raises and the set_experiment key that fills it) - no need to read REPORT.json back with the shell. SETTING: the reply's setting_change says which setting of the space group the delivery stands in; when it is not the ITA reference setting (an origin-shifted SHELXT solution, say) the symmetry NAMES are written true for the operator loop (Hall symbol carries the origin, H-M '?' when no tabulated symbol fits) and cb_op is the change of basis that WOULD reach the reference setting - reported, never applied (applied=false), because final.res/.fcf/.fab are the refinement's own files. Journals expect the reference setting: to deliver there, apply cb_op at the solution end and refine again. LABEL GATE: every non-H label must announce its scatterer's element by the SHELX convention (leading one/two letters: CL1 = Cl, OW1 = O, ZR1 = Zr) because checkCIF, the viewer, the grader and every reader type atoms from LABELS; a mismatch (N62 typed O, C1 typed Zr) or a surviving Q peak label is a blocking coherence issue that names the one-call fix (rename_atoms(mode='map') when the type is right, edit_atoms reassign when the label is right). A knowingly unconventional labelling passes with accept_label_mismatch=true plus reason (recorded in REPORT.json / MANIFEST.json); Q labels never pass.
Params: output_dir*: string; accept_label_mismatch: boolean = false; reason: string; summary_note: string = ""; unresolved: [string] = []; formula_moiety: string; status: provisional|diagnostic|final = provisional; pair_with_shelxl: boolean = true; shelxl_timeout_s: integer = 180.

# NU-1000 框架解析与精修

日期：2026-09-21。任务：task_20260921_192357。

## 结论与交付状态

依据本轮反射数据和合成图，已得到完整芘四羧酸配体连接Zr6节点的三维框架平均结构，工作空间群P6/mmm。交付节点n0055，版本3，状态为**diagnostic：可检查、可复算的完整框架候选，尚未达到可直接投稿的发表级**。未使用其他运行、参考结构或网络样品答案，未修改inputs。

框架候选完整性已达成；科学确证层级未达成。局部无序、端基/质子化、掩膜稳定性和实验元数据仍有实质限制。孔道内溶剂和客体没有作分子身份或原子模型指认；为框架精修保留了明确披露的孔道散射校正。

## 最终指标

以下数值来自n0055绑定的SHELXL-2019/3作业job_20260921_195821，不混用不同引擎或不同权重的指标。

|项目|结果|
|---|---|
|空间群；晶胞|P6/mmm；a=b=39.1900，c=16.6100 A；90、90、120度|
|波长；精修分辨率|0.68883 A；d_min=1.00 A|
|R1 [I>2sigma(I)]；R1全部|0.0849；0.1313|
|wR2全部；GooF|0.2526；0.912|
|独立反射；强反射；参数|4395；2063；155|
|最终几何/ADP restraints|0|
|差值密度最大/最小|+0.511 / -0.848 e/A^3|
|最大shift/s.u.绝对值；NPD原子|0.001；0|
|SHELXL Rint；选择范围完整度|0.5659；0.999|
|本地checkCIF|9 A、1 B、20 C、17 G，均保留并解释|

`run_shelxl(mode='check')`作业job_20260921_200134复现上述R值及收敛情况；PLATON作业job_20260921_200557_437354_cda093b8验证交付版本3的CIF/FCF。未外发到IUCr，也未声称SHELXL与未运行的另一精修引擎数值交叉通过。

## 化学与模型

合成图提供ZrCl4及芘核四(对羧基苯基)配体先验。按图得到游离配体C44H26O8；实际模型的配体非H骨架完整。20个独立非H位点全部各向异性，6个独立芳香H骑乘；对称扩展后每胞264C、132H、96O、18Zr，为单一3D连通框架。两独立Zr均8配位，Zr-O约2.15至2.25 A；堆积沿a、c及斜视三个方向检查。

模型计数式C88H44O32Zr6，Z=3，只统计已放入的原子。**未定位节点羟基/水等质子，末端O4/O5的完整化学身份不确定，因此这不是完整中性化学式，不能据此宣称实际含氢量、客体含量、实测密度或完整质量。**

输入INS只有原点重叠的C/H/N/O占位符。SHELXT给出的六个芳香“氧”依据图示碳骨架改为C后精修。Zr身份由投料、Zr6连接和CN8共同支持；波长位于Zr吸收边附近，采用DISP f'=-9.041、f''=2.772，不能用表观峰高把Zr误改为轻元素。

## 关键取舍

- 按壳层CC1/2及I/sigma采用1.00 A，而不是为降低R任意删反射。更高角至0.691 A的原始观测完整保存在final.hkl中。早期Laue筛查工具Rint=0.4281与最终SHELXL Rint=0.5659属于不同计算流程；最终报告使用后者，不互相替代。
- n0037无掩膜基线R1=0.1796、wR2=0.4739。首次收敛掩膜后的n0043在相同权重下为0.0845、0.2341，残差也显著改善，故保留数值校正。权重更新后得到最终指标，不能把不同权重下wR2的升降直接解释为模型变好/变坏。
- 掩膜体积17360 A^3（78.6%），343.6 e/cell，55循环收敛；后续刷新1000循环未收敛。没有以这些电子数估计未知溶剂数，详见VALIDATION.md。
- 更低R的n0045（0.0829）采用未收敛刷新掩膜，wR2和残差未改善，未交付。n0043较最终R1低0.0004，但权重不同；最终采用已收敛权重。局部配体和末端氧分裂未得到更可信构型，未采纳。
- 初始30个孔道位点经ghost_test有7组real、5组inconclusive，未被说成“幽灵”。撤除的是化学不成立的离散表示，真实散射用掩膜近似，所有原模型和试验保留。
- 最终没有SADI/SIMU等restraints。芳香H使用AFIX43、C-H=0.93 A、Uiso(H)=1.2Ueq(C)约束。FREE/EQIV仅去掉键表中误列的Zr...Zr直接键，不改变原子或散射。所有诊断分支restraints逐条列于VALIDATION.md。

## 尚未解决

1. 高Rint及弱衍射限制了精细几何；存在大ADP和未建立的局部/整体无序。所试分裂失败不能证明不存在其他合理构型。
2. 节点质子化和末端O配体身份未知；不强行补H或调节剂分子。
3. 掩膜刷新不稳定且靠近节点；最低角4类反射及另外2类反射在原始HKL中缺失。电子数、孔道组分定量和掩膜敏感性未获可靠解决。
4. 真实温度、仪器/辐射源、晶体外观尺寸、吸收校正、晶胞标准不确定度与p4p缺失。合成温度不能填成测量温度。
5. Zr吸收边附近Sasaki与checkCIF使用的Brennan-Cowan表有差异，需真实能量标定/实验信息进一步核实。完整平均空间群的采用也不是排除低对称无序的证明。

后续优先恢复原始采集/吸收校正记录及实验元数据，再考虑更高质量数据上的整体无序和末端化学模型；不能只靠增加约束或调权重消除这些信息缺口。

## 文件与复算

- `final.cif/res/ins/hkl/fcf/fab`：主交付；CIF文件名中的final是工具约定，状态仍为diagnostic。
- `VALIDATION.md`：每条A/B/C警报的含义、原因、检查及影响；另解释掩膜、重要G警报和全部试验restraints。
- `WORK_LOG.md`、`calculations/README.md`：步骤、节点及作业索引；`calculations/`保存求解、全部SHELXL输入/输出日志、节点快照和PLATON原始报告。
- `images/`：三方向框架堆积图；`analysis/audit_delivery.py/json`：只读反射缺失和原子表核对。
- 独立人工复算应在副本目录保留同名`final.ins + final.hkl + final.fab`，运行给定SHELXL的`shelxl final`。工作台内继续改模仍应经CrystalPilot工具，以保留审计链。详见计算记录说明，**不得遗失ABIN所需的final.fab**。

## 孔道散射校正与化学披露

最初SHELXT额外孔道位点存在0.75–1.19 A非化学短接触和极大/漂移ADP。ghost_test的12组中7组real、5组inconclusive，没有提供“全部是假原子”的证据。保留全部诊断记录后，n0032显式承认真实密度，撤除其无可靠分子解释的离散表示。随后完整框架、全非H各向异性、芳香H和元素核对完成，才作掩膜比较；不同时保留这些孔道原子与掩膜双重计数。

n0042使用d_min=1.0 A、溶剂探针1.2 A、收缩半径1.2 A、网格因子0.25、最小孔体积8 A^3、网格160x160x72，55循环收敛。一个连通掩膜区17360.0 A^3，为全胞78.6%；343.6 e/cell。固定同一权重时，n0037无掩膜R1/wR2=0.1796/0.4739，残差+1.519/-1.157；n0043为0.0845/0.2341，残差+0.505/-0.845，因此保留校正。

该体积为算法探针下的掩膜体积，不当作独立实验孔容。掩膜对节点的最近距离提示约2.2 A（Zr1）、2.7 A（Zr2），可能耦合端基/节点残差；O1至O6均仍显式建模，没有把末端配位O当作可忽略孔道溶剂删除。边界和参数敏感性未充分确证。

更新框架后n0044重算1000循环仍不收敛，电子数77.5 e/cell不采信为化学计量；n0045 R1虽略低，但wR2和残差未改善，不交付。最终采用首次收敛掩膜的固定ABIN系数，`final.fab`为复算必需。这不是声称已得到自洽唯一的溶剂模型。

合成图有DEF/BA/TFA先验，但没有当前晶体孔道内组分/占有率的独立证据。本轮也未要求指认客体。因此343.6电子不能分配成若干DEF或其它客体分子；无有依据的客体moiety可填写。再加最低角4类反射缺失，绝不由低电子数推论孔道已经脱溶剂。CIF的式量、F000、计算密度均仅对应已建框架原子，不代表含所有质子/孔道物的实际晶体组成。

## 孔道散射校正与化学披露

最初SHELXT额外孔道位点存在0.75–1.19 A非化学短接触和极大/漂移ADP。ghost_test的12组中7组real、5组inconclusive，没有提供“全部是假原子”的证据。保留全部诊断记录后，n0032显式承认真实密度，撤除其无可靠分子解释的离散表示。随后完整框架、全非H各向异性、芳香H和元素核对完成，才作掩膜比较；不同时保留这些孔道原子与掩膜双重计数。

n0042使用d_min=1.0 A、溶剂探针1.2 A、收缩半径1.2 A、网格因子0.25、最小孔体积8 A^3、网格160x160x72，55循环收敛。一个连通掩膜区17360.0 A^3，为全胞78.6%；343.6 e/cell。固定同一权重时，n0037无掩膜R1/wR2=0.1796/0.4739，残差+1.519/-1.157；n0043为0.0845/0.2341，残差+0.505/-0.845，因此保留校正。

该体积为算法探针下的掩膜体积，不当作独立实验孔容。掩膜对节点的最近距离提示约2.2 A（Zr1）、2.7 A（Zr2），可能耦合端基/节点残差；O1至O6均仍显式建模，没有把末端配位O当作可忽略孔道溶剂删除。边界和参数敏感性未充分确证。

更新框架后n0044重算1000循环仍不收敛，电子数77.5 e/cell不采信为化学计量；n0045 R1虽略低，但wR2和残差未改善，不交付。最终采用首次收敛掩膜的固定ABIN系数，`final.fab`为复算必需。这不是声称已得到自洽唯一的溶剂模型。

合成图有DEF/BA/TFA先验，但没有当前晶体孔道内组分/占有率的独立证据。本轮也未要求指认客体。因此343.6电子不能分配成若干DEF或其它客体分子；无有依据的客体moiety可填写。再加最低角4类反射缺失，绝不由低电子数推论孔道已经脱溶剂。CIF的式量、F000、计算密度均仅对应已建框架原子，不代表含所有质子/孔道物的实际晶体组成。

_meta.tool_description:
Record a write_outputs delivery in a readable MANIFEST.json after a completeness check: final.cif + final.fcf + final.res + REPORT.json + SUMMARY.md + VALIDATION.md present, final.fab for a masked model, checkcif.json produced by run_checkcif linked to this node and delivery revision, no coherence issues, and the label/element gate re-run on the delivered files (a non-H label announcing a different element than its type, or a Q label, is fatal unless write_outputs recorded label_mismatch_accepted with a reason; Q labels never pass). TWO OUTCOMES depending on the delivery's status: a 'provisional' delivery is PROMOTED to 'final' - every blocking item (each A-level checkCIF alert, each REPORT.json 'unresolved' entry) must be gone or explicitly waived, each with its own reason (recorded in REPORT.json finalized.waivers and MANIFEST.json waived; a waiver is a disclosure, not a fix - the CIF header then names how many blocking items were waived instead of implying every one was resolved). A 'diagnostic' delivery (NOT a structure claim) is instead SEALED as-is - status stays 'diagnostic', no waivers are needed or accepted, and every unresolved blocking item is listed in REPORT.json/MANIFEST.json open_items; it is never promoted to 'final'. Either way this rewrites the status header of final.cif, updates REPORT.json and rebuilds MANIFEST.json over every file in the directory (SUMMARY/VALIDATION/checkcif included). Default target = the newest delivery under 'CrystalPilot Results/'. A failed call changes nothing and lists what is missing.
Params: output_dir: string; waivers: [{item,reason}] = []; note: string = ""; unmet_goals: [string] = [].
